verdict.rationale: The business services page links to an "Open Data Portal Historic Business License Search," which suggests the Division's business-license registry data is published as an open dataset rather than only through scraping. However, this is a single thin link label, and its wording ("Search") leaves unclear whether bulk download or export is actually offered. The other evidence covers only authenticated filing portals, so the extent of any bulk data publication is unproven. Missing for 10: confirmation of bulk downloadable files (CSV/API export), any tax statistics or other datasets beyond historic business licenses, documentation of dataset formats and update cadence, and independent or hands-on verification of the download.
